title: EvoGen-Harness: Learning Where and How to Evolve Image-Generation Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.00383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems can be improved without modifying generator parameters by adapting the external system around frozen generators. However, existing approaches typically optimize a predefined dimension, such as prompts, routing, or workflows, restricting the space in which generation failures can be corrected. Allowing multiple generator-external responsibilities to evolve provides a broader adaptation space, but introduces a new challenge: visual feedback reveals what failed, but not where persistent evolution should occur or how this space should be explored efficiently. We introduce EvoGen-Harness, a generator-agnostic framework for multi-responsibility image-generation harness evolution, together with Trace (Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution). translated_title: EvoGen-Harness：学习在何处以及如何演化图像生成外围框架
translated_abstract: 现代文生图（T2I）系统无需修改生成器参数即可获得改进，其方式是围绕冻结的生成器适配其外部系统。然而，现有方法通常只优化某个预定义的维度，例如提示词、路由或工作流，这限制了可用于纠正生成失败的空间。允许多项生成器外部职责共同演化能够提供更广阔的适配空间，但这也带来了新的挑战：视觉反馈只能揭示什么失败了，却无法揭示持续演化应当发生在何处，以及应当如何高效地探索这一空间。我们提出 EvoGen-Harness，一个与生成器无关的多职责图像生成外围框架演化框架，并同时提出 Trace（轨迹相对归因与协同演化，Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution）。Trace 在多次随机执行中聚合证据，将失败归因作为搜索先验以聚焦候选更新，并逐步重新归因……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 提出 EvoGen-Harness 框架与 Trace 方法，通过聚合多次随机执行中的证据并将失败归因作为搜索先验，实现图像生成外围框架多职责的自动协同演化，从而在不修改生成器参数的前提下更全面地纠正文生图系统的生成失败。
en_tdlr: EvoGen-Harness introduces Trace, which aggregates evidence across stochastic executions and uses failure attribution as a search prior to co-evolve multiple generator-external responsibilities, enabling broader correction of text-to-image generation failures without modifying generator parameters.
